recommendation.summary: Plant second-crop corn between Feb 1 and Feb 20.
recommendation.explanation: Corn planted in this window usually reaches grain fill before the June–July cold. Later plantings meet frost while the grain is still filling.

windows.explanation: Grain fill ends before late May in most past years, so June frost rarely hurts the crop.
Grain fill moves into June. In 3 of the last 10 years, frost reached this area in June.
The crop would still be filling grain in July, the coldest month. Frost damage is likely.

events.label: Frost / cold
events.explanation: Nights cold enough for frost happened in June or July in 3 of the last 10 years. Low spots in the field can be colder.

source.note: Past records, not a forecast. Risk = how often it happened in past years.
